screening_reasons.IN-eval: datasets, corpora, metrics or evaluation methodology we need
screening_reasons.IN-context: background needed to interpret core work
screening_reasons.EX-no-access: no accessible full text and abstract insufficient
screening_reasons.EX-superseded: superseded by a later version from the same authors
screening_reasons.EX-weak: too thin to support claims (e.g. 2-page abstract with no evaluation)
screening_reasons.EX-language: not in a language we can read reliably
